categories.evidence: Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h to clarify the callback contract in the libbitcoinkernel C API.
categories.rationale: Clarifies the C API callback contract so language binding authors can avoid undefined behavior or crashes when handling empty buffer slices.
